## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`) under the
      [Developer Certificate of Origin](../DCO); contributions are licensed
      under EUPL-1.2 (inbound = outbound, no CLA).
- [ ] New files carry SPDX headers or a `REUSE.toml` annotation (`reuse lint` passes).
- [ ] Tests added or updated; `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm test` pass.
- [ ] Schema changes come as a new forward-only migration, with the spec updated.
- [ ] Documentation updated (README, `deploy/`, `identity/`, spec) where behaviour changed.
- [ ] No secrets, personal data or student data in code, fixtures or logs.
